propositions: ProductionBatchRunner.run receives req.usd_budget as a per-plan cost cap override but cannot apply it because run_pass1 calls shed_to_budget which computes the cap internally with no injection point.
REBAR_PLAN_REVIEW_BUDGET is read as a base and centrality-scaled, making it not a true cap override; an explicit parameter seam is needed to honor verbatim final caps.
An optional cap_override parameter must thread through ProductionBatchRunner.run -> run_pass1 -> shed_to_budget, defaulting to None and using the value verbatim without centrality scaling.
The cap_override seam must distinguish between None (computed cap), explicit 0.0 (shed everything), and other numeric values, recorded with cap_source (override|computed) in coverage["budget"].
Two stub implementations of run_pass1 in test_pass1_finder_model.py and test_model_class_ladder.py must accept the new cap_override parameter to maintain monkeypatch compatibility.
